name: Kruskal's MST Algorithm
description: Finds the Minimum Spanning Tree by greedily adding the cheapest edge that doesn't create a cycle, using Union-Find.
aim: Build MST by sorting all edges by weight and adding each edge if it connects two different components (detected via Union-Find).
howItWorks: Sort all edges by weight ascending
Initialize Union-Find with each vertex as own set
For each edge (u,v,w): if u and v in different components: add to MST
If adding causes cycle (same component): skip
Repeat until MST has V-1 edges

realWorld: Network cable laying — minimum cost connections
whenToUse: Minimum spanning tree in sparse graphs
